mainTopic: רבן גמליאל's rule of אין גט אחר גט ואין מאמר אחר מאמר: its reasoning, אביי's explanation, the practical cases in the ברייתא, and how it fits with שמואל through אין זיקה
overview: The משנה taught that רבן גמליאל holds a second גט after a גט, or a second מאמר after a מאמר, has no effect. The גמרא first explains that he is unsure whether a גט pushes away ייבום and whether a מאמר acquires, so either way the second act adds nothing. אביי challenges this from a ברייתא where רבן גמליאל agrees that a third act works after a ביאה that followed a מאמר or a גט. Under the doubt, that ביאה might count as a first ביאה, and nothing should work after it. So אביי gives a new explanation: רבן גמליאל is certain, but a גט only pushes away and a מאמר only acquires. Repeating the same act does nothing, while two different acts both work. The רבנן hold that every גט and מאמר was set up to work fully. The ביאה in the ברייתא is a ביאה פסולה: stronger than a מאמר in one way and weaker in another. A ברייתא then gives practical cases of a גט or מאמר to each of two יבמות, with רבן גמליאל and the חכמים disagreeing. The גמרא asks whether רבן גמליאל's ruling contradicts שמואל and answers that שמואל follows the view of יש זיקה while רבן גמליאל holds אין זיקה. It then begins a new challenge built on that point, which continues on the next amud.

steps.title: What is רבן גמליאל's reason?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why רבן גמליאל holds that a second גט or second מאמר has no effect.
steps.simpleTranslation: What is the reason of רבן גמליאל?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks for the reasoning behind רבן גמליאל's ruling in the משנה. This question sets up the explanation that comes next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the משנה, רבן גמליאל said that a second גט after a גט, or a second מאמר after a מאמר, does nothing. The רבנן disagree and hold that the second act does work. The גמרא wants to know what logic makes רבן גמליאל think the second act is empty.

keyTerms.meaning: What is the reason?
The תנא whose view in the משנה is being explained

phrases.english: What is the reason of Rabban Gamliel?
phrases.notes: He means רבן גמליאל's ruling in the משנה: a second גט after a גט does nothing, and a second מאמר after a מאמר does nothing.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens the analysis of רבן גמליאל's view from the משנה.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The reasoning behind אין גט אחר גט ואין מאמר אחר מאמר.

steps.title: He is unsure how strong a גט and a מאמר are
steps.stepSummary: רבן גמליאל is in doubt whether a גט pushes away ייבום and whether a מאמר acquires the יבמה.
steps.simpleTranslation: Because he is unsure about a גט: does it push away ייבום or not? And about a מאמר: does it acquire her or not?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that רבן גמליאל has a double doubt. He is unsure whether a גט really pushes away ייבום, and unsure whether a מאמר really acquires the יבמה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבן גמליאל is not saying that a גט or a מאמר is clearly strong or clearly weak. He simply does not know which it is. The next two steps show how this doubt makes the second act useless.

keyTerms.meaning: He is in doubt about it
A divorce document; here, one a יבם gives to a יבמה
Pushes away, meaning it blocks ייבום
A rabbinic kind of betrothal that a יבם does with a יבמה
Acquires

phrases.english: Because he is uncertain about a bill of divorce,
whether it pushes away or does not push away.
phrases.notes: Push away what? The ייבום, meaning the יבם's ability to marry her.

phrases.aramaic: מַאֲמָר — אִי קָנֵי אִי לָא קָנֵי.
phrases.english: Levirate betrothal: whether it acquires or does not acquire.

steps.triggerLanguage: דִּמְסַפְּקָא לֵיהּ גֵּט אִי דָּחֵי אִי לָא דָּחֵי
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: רבן גמליאל is in doubt about the power of both a גט and a מאמר.

steps.title: Why a second גט adds nothing
steps.stepSummary: Whichever way the doubt about a גט goes, the second גט accomplishes nothing.
steps.simpleTranslation: A גט: does it push away or not? If the first one pushes away, what does the second one do? If the first does not push away, the second does not push away either.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא works through both sides of the doubt about a גט. It shows that either way, the second גט is useless.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If a גט really pushes away ייבום, the first גט already did the job, so the second has nothing left to do. If a גט does not push away ייבום, then the second גט is no stronger than the first and fails too. Both sides of the doubt lead to the same result: אין גט אחר גט.

keyTerms.meaning: The first one
The later one, the second one
What does it accomplish?

phrases.aramaic: גֵּט — אִי דָּחֵי אִי לָא דָּחֵי.
phrases.english: A bill of divorce: whether it pushes away or does not push away.
If the first one pushes away,
what does the later one accomplish?
If the first one does not push away,
the later one also does not push away.

steps.triggerLanguage: אִי קַמָּא דָּחֵי בָּתְרָא מַאי קָעָבֵיד
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Spells out the גט half of the doubt given in step 2.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Whether a גט is strong or weak, a second גט adds nothing.

steps.title: Why a second מאמר adds nothing
steps.stepSummary: The same reasoning applies to מאמר: whichever way the doubt goes, the second מאמר does nothing.
steps.simpleTranslation: A מאמר: does it acquire or not? If the first acquires, what does the second do? And if the first does not acquire, the second does not acquire either.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא runs the same two-sided reasoning for מאמר. Either way, the second מאמר is useless.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If a מאמר acquires, the first מאמר already acquired, and the second has no job left. If a מאמר does not acquire, the second fails just as the first did. This completes the explanation of אין מאמר אחר מאמר.

keyTerms.meaning: Also, too

steps.whatToRemember: רבן גמליאל's reasoning is a doubt, not a firm rule. Because both sides of the doubt make the second act useless, a second גט or second מאמר does nothing.

phrases.aramaic: מַאֲמָר אִי קָנֵי אִי לָא קָנֵי,
phrases.english: Levirate betrothal: whether it acquires or does not acquire.
If the first one acquires,
what does the later one accomplish?
And if the first one does not acquire,
the later one also does not acquire.

steps.triggerLanguage: אִי קַמָּא קָנֵי בָּתְרָא מַאי קָעָבֵיד
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Applies the same logic from step 3 to מאמר.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Whether a מאמר is strong or weak, a second מאמר adds nothing.

steps.title: אביי quotes a ברייתא where רבן גמליאל agrees a later act works
steps.stepSummary: אביי cites a ברייתא: רבן גמליאל agrees that a גט works after a מאמר and a מאמר after a גט, and that a third act works after a ביאה combined with a מאמר or a גט.
steps.simpleTranslation: אביי challenged him: רבן גמליאל agrees that there is a גט after a מאמר, and a מאמר after a גט. He also agrees there is a גט after ביאה and מאמר, and a מאמר after ביאה and גט.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי brings a ברייתא to challenge the explanation just given. This step lays out the source, and the next step explains exactly why it is a problem.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ברייתא lists cases where רבן גמליאל agrees that a later act does take effect. The difficult cases are the last two, where a third act comes after a ביאה that was itself preceded by a מאמר or a גט. These cases will clash with the doubt that was used to explain רבן גמליאל.

keyTerms.meaning: He challenged him, usually from a תנאי source
And he agrees
Intercourse, the act that completes ייבום
After

phrases.english: Abaye raised an objection to him:
And Rabban Gamliel agrees
that there is a bill of divorce after levirate betrothal,
and levirate betrothal after the bill of divorce.
And a bill of divorce after intercourse and levirate betrothal,
phrases.notes: Picture three יבמות: a מאמר with one, then ביאה with a second, then a גט to a third. The גט still works.

phrases.english: and levirate betrothal after intercourse and a bill of divorce.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the explanation of steps 2 through 4 using a ברייתא.
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that רבן גמליאל is in doubt about the power of a גט and a מאמר.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The ברייתא has רבן גמליאל agreeing that a third act works after a ביאה that came after a מאמר or a גט. The next step shows why this cannot fit with the doubt.

steps.title: If the first act might be nothing, the ביאה should finish everything
steps.stepSummary: If רבן גמליאל is in doubt, the ביאה after the מאמר or גט might be a first ביאה, and nothing should work after a first ביאה.
steps.simpleTranslation: And if רבן גמליאל is unsure, let the ביאה be like a ביאה at the very start, and let it acquire fully. For we learned in the משנה: ביאה, when it comes first, nothing works after it.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי explains why the ברייתא is a problem. Under the doubt, the ביאה could be the first real act, and the משנה says nothing works after a first ביאה. So the third act should not work, yet רבן גמליאל agrees that it does.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Take the case of a מאמר, then a ביאה, then a גט. If a מאמר does not acquire, the ביאה is really the first act and acquires completely, and the משנה rules that nothing works after that. Since רבן גמליאל is unsure whether the מאמר did anything, he could not be sure the later גט works. Yet the ברייתא says he agrees that it does, so the doubt cannot explain the ברייתא.

keyTerms.meaning: That is at the very beginning, the first act
We learned in a משנה
Intercourse; another word for ביאה
Nothing has any effect after it

steps.confusionAlert: Do not think אביי is saying a ביאה never allows later acts. His point is only that if the earlier מאמר or גט might be empty, this ביאה might be the first act, and a first ביאה ends the whole process.

phrases.english: And if Rabban Gamliel is uncertain,
let it be like intercourse at the beginning, and let it acquire.
phrases.notes: "It" is the ביאה that came after the מאמר or גט, since that earlier act might have done nothing.

phrases.english: For we learned:
Intercourse, when it is at the beginning,
nothing is effective after it.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאִי מְסַפְּקָא לֵיהּ לְרַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל תִּהְוֵי כְּבִיאָה דִּלְכַתְּחִלָּה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Spells out the logic of אביי's objection from the ברייתא in step 5.
steps.kashyaTarget: The explanation that רבן גמליאל is in doubt about whether a גט pushes away ייבום and whether a מאמר acquires.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Under the doubt, the earlier מאמר or גט may be empty, which makes the ביאה a first ביאה. The משנה rules that nothing works after a first ביאה, yet רבן גמליאל agrees the third act works.
steps.whyThisMatters: This objection forces the גמרא to rethink the reason behind רבן גמליאל's view, since the simple doubt explanation cannot handle the ברייתא.

steps.title: אביי's new answer: each act works in its own separate way
steps.stepSummary: אביי drops the idea that רבן גמליאל is unsure. A גט pushes away and a מאמר acquires, and each works in only one way. So the same act twice does nothing, but two different acts both work.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, אביי said: Really, רבן גמליאל is sure that a גט pushes away ייבום and a מאמר acquires the יבמה. But the רבנן said that a גט works on the יבמה in one way, and a מאמר works on her in another way. A גט after a גט does not push away, because the first one already pushed away. A מאמר after a מאמר does not acquire, because the first one already acquired. But with a גט after a מאמר, or a מאמר after a גט, one act pushes away and the other acquires.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives a brand-new answer to the challenge from the ברייתא in steps 5-6. רבן גמליאל is not in doubt at all.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The old answer said each act was unsure, which made the ברייתא hard to explain. Now each act is certain but limited to one job: a גט only pushes away and a מאמר only acquires. A repeat of the same job adds nothing, but a different job still has something to do.

keyTerms.meaning: It is obvious to him; he has no doubt
Pushes away (here: pushes the יבמה away from ייבום)
Acquires
In one respect / in one way
The first one

steps.whatToRemember: According to אביי, רבן גמליאל is certain. A גט only pushes away and a מאמר only acquires, so repeating the same act does nothing, while mixing the two acts works.
steps.confusionAlert: Do not mix this up with step 2. There, רבן גמליאל was in doubt. Here אביי says the opposite: he is sure, and the limit comes from each act having only one job.

phrases.english: Rather, Abaye said:
Actually, it is obvious to Rabban Gamliel
that a bill of divorce pushes away and levirate betrothal acquires.
However, the Sages said:

phrases.aramaic: הָא יְבָמָה — בְּחַד צַד מַהֲנֵי בַּהּ גֵּט,
phrases.english: This yevama: in one respect a bill of divorce works on her,
and in another respect levirate betrothal works on her.
A bill of divorce after a bill of divorce does not push away,
since the first one already pushed away for him.
And levirate betrothal after levirate betrothal does not acquire,
since the first one already acquired for him.

phrases.aramaic: גֵּט אַחַר מַאֲמָר וּמַאֲמָר אַחַר הַגֵּט,
phrases.english: A bill of divorce after levirate betrothal, and levirate betrothal after the bill of divorce:

phrases.aramaic: הַאי מִילְּתָא קָא דָחֵי וְהַאי מִילְּתָא קָא קָנֵי.
phrases.english: this act pushes away and that act acquires.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֶלָּא אָמַר אַבָּיֵי, לְעוֹלָם פְּשִׁיטָא לֵיהּ לְרַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Replaces the 'רבן גמליאל is unsure' explanation, which steps 5-6 knocked down
steps.terutzResolutionType: Reframing the underlying reason: certainty with separate jobs instead of doubt
steps.terutzHavaAmina: רבן גמליאל was unsure whether a גט and a מאמר work, so a ביאה after them might count as a first ביאה
steps.terutzMaskana: רבן גמליאל is certain. Each act does one job only, so the same act twice does nothing, while different acts both work

steps.title: Why the רבנן say a second act does work
steps.stepSummary: The רבנן hold that a גט and a מאמר were set up to work for each and every case, so a second one works too.
steps.simpleTranslation: And the רבנן? They hold that the Sages set up a גט and a מאמר with a יבמה to work for each and every one.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains the other side: why the רבנן disagree with רבן גמליאל and let a second גט or מאמר work.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For the רבנן, every גט and every מאמר was set up to be fully effective. The first act does not use anything up, so a later act of the same kind still works.

keyTerms.meaning: Each and every one
They set up (a rule made by the Sages)

phrases.english: And the Rabbis?

phrases.aramaic: כֹּל חַד וְחַד תַּקִּינוּ לֵיה רַבָּנַן
phrases.english: For each and every one the Sages instituted
a bill of divorce and levirate betrothal with a yevama.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְרַבָּנַן: כֹּל חַד וְחַד תַּקִּינוּ לֵיה רַבָּנַן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the opposing view to the reasoning אביי gave for רבן גמליאל
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why the רבנן let a second גט or מאמר work
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The Sages set up each act to work fully every time, for each and every case

steps.title: Invalid intercourse: stronger than a מאמר in one way, weaker in another
steps.stepSummary: A ביאה that comes after a מאמר or a גט is a ביאה פסולה. It works after a מאמר, unlike a second מאמר. But after a גט it does not acquire everything the גט left behind, unlike a מאמר. That is why another act can still work after it.
steps.simpleTranslation: This invalid intercourse is better than a מאמר and worse than a מאמר. Better: a מאמר after a מאמר does not work, but a ביאה after a מאמר does work. Worse: a מאמר after a גט acquires all that the גט left, but a ביאה after a גט does not acquire all that the גט left.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי now answers the last part of the challenge from step 6: why can another act still work after a ביאה that came after a מאמר or a גט?
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ביאה here is not a full first ביאה. It is a ביאה פסולה, because it came after an earlier act. It is strong enough to work after a מאמר, but after a גט it does not fully acquire what is left. So it does not close the door the way a real first ביאה would, and a later act can still have an effect.

keyTerms.meaning: Invalid intercourse: a ביאה that comes after a מאמר or a גט
Better / stronger
Worse / weaker
What the גט left over (the part of the bond the גט did not remove)

steps.whatToRemember: A ביאה פסולה is stronger than a מאמר because it works after a מאמר. It is weaker because after a גט it does not acquire everything that is left, so another act can still work after it.
steps.whyThisMatters: This closes the challenge from steps 5-6. The ביאה in the ברייתא is not a full first ביאה, so another act working after it is no problem.

phrases.english: And this invalid intercourse:
is better than levirate betrothal and worse than levirate betrothal.
Better than levirate betrothal:

phrases.aramaic: דְּאִילּוּ מַאֲמָר אַחַר מַאֲמָר לָא מַהֲנֵי,
phrases.english: for whereas levirate betrothal after levirate betrothal does not work,
intercourse after levirate betrothal does work.
And worse than levirate betrothal:
for whereas levirate betrothal after the bill of divorce
acquires all of what the bill of divorce left,
intercourse after the bill of divorce

phrases.aramaic: לָא קָנְיָא לֵיהּ לְכוּלֵּיהּ שִׁיּוּרָא דְגֵט.
phrases.english: does not acquire for him all of what the bill of divorce left.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְהַאי בִּיאָה פְּסוּלָה עֲדִיפָא מִמַּאֲמָר וּגְרִיעָא מִמַּאֲמָר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes אביי's answer by explaining the ביאה part of the ברייתא
steps.kashyaTarget: The challenge in step 6 that nothing should work after the ביאה
steps.terutzResolutionType: Defining the case: the ביאה is a ביאה פסולה, not a full first ביאה
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The ביאה after a מאמר or a גט might be a first ביאה, after which nothing works
steps.terutzMaskana: It is a ביאה פסולה. After a גט it does not acquire everything that is left, so a later act can still work

steps.title: A ברייתא gives a case of 'no גט after a גט'
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא gives the case: two יבמות fall to one יבם, and he gives each of them a גט. רבן גמליאל says he does חליצה with the first, is forbidden to marry her relatives, and is allowed to marry the second one's relatives.
steps.simpleTranslation: The Sages taught: In what case did רבן גמליאל say there is no גט after a גט? Two יבמות fell to one יבם, and he gave a גט to this one and a גט to that one. רבן גמליאל says: He does חליצה with the first one and is forbidden to marry her relatives, and he is allowed to marry the second one's relatives.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא starts a new section. It brings a ברייתא that shows what 'no גט after a גט' looks like in a real case.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Only the first גט counts. So the first woman is the one who needs חליצה, and her relatives become forbidden to him. The second גט did nothing, so the second woman's relatives stay permitted.

keyTerms.meaning: How / in what case
Who fell to a יבם (became his for ייבום)
Does חליצה
Her relatives

phrases.english: The Sages taught:
In what case did Rabban Gamliel say
there is no bill of divorce after a bill of divorce?

phrases.aramaic: שְׁתֵּי יְבָמוֹת שֶׁנָּפְלוּ לִפְנֵי יָבָם אֶחָד,
phrases.english: Two yevamot who fell before one yavam,
phrases.notes: In this case the two women are wives of the same brother who died, so both fall to this one יבם.

phrases.english: and he gave a bill of divorce to this one and a bill of divorce to that one.
Rabban Gamliel says:
He performs halitza with the first one and is forbidden to her relatives,
and he is permitted to the relatives of the second one.

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: כֵּיצַד אָמַר רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אֵין גֵּט אַחַר גֵּט
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves from the reasoning behind רבן גמליאל's rule to a ברייתא that shows a practical case of it
steps.mimraCoreRuling: When two יבמות each get a גט, only the first גט counts. He does חליצה with the first and is forbidden to her relatives, but the second one's relatives stay permitted

steps.title: The חכמים' view on a גט to each of two widows
steps.stepSummary: The חכמים rule that when a יבם gives a גט to each of two יבמות, both גיטין work. He is forbidden to the relatives of both, and he still does חליצה with one of them. The same applies to two brothers and one widow.
steps.simpleTranslation: But the חכמים say: if he gave a גט to this one and a גט to that one, he is forbidden to marry the relatives of both of them, and he does חליצה with one of them. And you say the same thing when there are two יבמים and one יבמה.
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא from step 10 continues. After quoting רבן גמליאל, it now gives the opposing view of the חכמים.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For רבן גמליאל only the first גט counts, so the second woman's relatives stay permitted. For the חכמים the second גט also works, so both women's relatives become forbidden. Either way, one חליצה is enough to finish the case for both.

keyTerms.meaning: The Sages, the majority view arguing with רבן גמליאל
Female relatives (like a sister or mother) that become forbidden to him
The ceremony that releases a widow from the יבם
Brothers of the dead husband, who are bound to the widow

phrases.english: But the Sages say:
If he gave a bill of divorce to this one and a bill of divorce to that one,
he is forbidden to the relatives of both of them,
and he does חליצה with one of them.
And so you would say
with two brothers-in-law and one widow.
phrases.notes: He means two brothers who each give a גט to the same widow. The same argument applies there.

steps.triggerLanguage: וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים: נָתַן גֵּט לָזוֹ וְגֵט לָזוֹ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the ברייתא begun in step 10 with the opposing view of the חכמים.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to the חכמים, a second גט works: he is forbidden to the relatives of both women, and one חליצה is required.

steps.title: The same argument when he gives a מאמר to each widow
steps.stepSummary: The ברייתא now shows where רבן גמליאל says there is no מאמר after a מאמר. If a יבם gives a מאמר to each of two widows, רבן גמליאל says only the first counts. The חכמים say both count.
steps.simpleTranslation: How did רבן גמליאל say there is no מאמר after a מאמר? Two יבמות fell before one יבם, and he gave a מאמר to this one and a מאמר to that one. רבן גמליאל says: he gives a גט to the first and does חליצה with her. He is forbidden to her relatives and permitted to the second one's relatives. The חכמים say: he gives a גט to both, he is forbidden to the relatives of both, and he does חליצה with one of them. And you say the same thing with two יבמים and one יבמה.
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא gives the parallel case for מאמר. It shows that רבן גמליאל and the חכמים argue the same way about a second מאמר as they did about a second גט.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For רבן גמליאל the second מאמר does nothing, so the second woman needs no גט and her relatives stay permitted. For the חכמים the second מאמר also takes hold, so each woman needs her own גט and both sets of relatives are forbidden. This fits step 8: the חכמים hold that a גט and a מאמר work in every case.

keyTerms.meaning: How? In what case? It opens an explanation of a rule
A rabbinic act of יבום-betrothal, done with money or a document
A second מאמר after a first one has no effect
The dead husband's brother

phrases.english: How did רבן גמליאל say
there is no levirate betrothal after levirate betrothal?

phrases.aramaic: שְׁתֵּי יְבָמוֹת שֶׁנָּפְלוּ לִפְנֵי יָבָם אֶחָד,
phrases.english: Two widows who fell before one brother-in-law,
and he made a levirate betrothal with this one and a levirate betrothal with that one.
רבן גמליאל says:
He gives a bill of divorce to the first and does חליצה with her,
and he is forbidden to her relatives,
and permitted to the relatives of the second.
But the Sages say: He gives a bill of divorce to both of them,
and he is forbidden to the relatives of both of them,
and he does חליצה with one of them.

phrases.aramaic: וְכֵן אַתָּה אוֹמֵר בִּשְׁנֵי יְבָמִים וִיבָמָה אַחַת.
phrases.english: And so you would say with two brothers-in-law and one widow.

steps.triggerLanguage: כֵּיצַד אָמַר רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אֵין מַאֲמָר אַחַר מַאֲמָר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the parallel מאמר case, alongside the גט case from steps 10–11.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: רבן גמליאל: a second מאמר does nothing, so only the first woman needs a גט. חכמים: both מאמרות work, so both women need a גט.

steps.title: Does רבן גמליאל's ruling contradict שמואל?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא goes back to רבן גמליאל's ruling in the גט case. There, a חליצה with the first woman, who already got a גט, is enough for both. That seems to contradict שמואל, who said a חליצה with a woman who received a גט does not free her צרה.
steps.simpleTranslation: The Master said: he gives a גט to this one and a גט to that one. רבן גמליאל says: he does חליצה with the first, is forbidden to her relatives, and is permitted to the second one's relatives. Shall we say this refutes שמואל? For שמואל said: if he did חליצה with the woman who got a גט, the צרה is not freed!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes back a line of the ברייתא and challenges שמואל with it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In רבן גמליאל's case the first woman already received a גט, and one חליצה with her ends the whole case, so the second woman is freed too. שמואל said that a חליצה with a woman who got a גט does not free the צרה. The two rulings seem to clash.

keyTerms.meaning: "The Master said": the גמרא is quoting back an earlier source to discuss it
"Shall we say this is a refutation?"
The woman who already received a גט
The co-wife: the other widow of the same dead husband
Was freed, released from יבום

steps.confusionAlert: Notice that in רבן גמליאל's case the חליצה is done with the first woman after she already got a גט. That is exactly the case שמואל talks about.

phrases.english: The Master said:
phrases.notes: This quotes back the ברייתא from step 10.

phrases.english: He gives a bill of divorce to this one and a bill of divorce to that one.
רבן גמליאל says: He does חליצה with the first
and is forbidden to her relatives, and permitted to the relatives of the second.
Shall we say this is a refutation of שמואל?
For שמואל said:

phrases.aramaic: חָלַץ לְבַעֲלַת הַגֵּט — לֹא נִפְטְרָה צָרָה!
phrases.english: If he did חליצה with the woman who received a bill of divorce, the co-wife is not freed!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Uses רבן גמליאל's ruling from the ברייתא to challenge a separate rule of שמואל.
steps.kashyaTarget: שמואל's rule that a חליצה with a woman who received a גט does not free the צרה.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: רבן גמליאל lets one חליצה with a woman who already got a גט end the case for both women, which goes against שמואל.

steps.title: שמואל's rule only follows the view that יש זיקה
steps.stepSummary: שמואל answers that his rule follows only the view that יש זיקה. רבן גמליאל holds אין זיקה, so the ברייתא does not refute שמואל.
steps.simpleTranslation: שמואל can say to you: when I said my rule, I said it according to the one who holds יש זיקה. But רבן גמליאל holds אין זיקה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא defends שמואל. His rule rests on one side of a debate, and רבן גמליאל is on the other side.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the זיקה is strong (יש זיקה), a weak חליצה with a woman who got a גט cannot cut the bond tying the צרה. If the זיקה is not strong (אין זיקה), as רבן גמליאל holds, one חליצה is enough to free both. So the two rulings do not clash, because they follow different views.

keyTerms.meaning: The bond tying the widow to the יבם before יבום or חליצה
The view that this bond is strong and real
The view that this bond is not strong
According to the opinion of

steps.whyThisMatters: It shows that the question of whether יש זיקה can decide how strong a חליצה needs to be to free a צרה.

phrases.english: שמואל could say to you:
When I said it,
it was according to the one who says the levirate bond is substantial.
But רבן גמליאל holds the levirate bond is not substantial,

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר לְךָ שְׁמוּאֵל: כִּי אֲמַרִי אֲנָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge against שמואל from step 13.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Limiting the rule's scope: שמואל's rule only holds for one side of a debate.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: שמואל's rule applies to everyone, so רבן גמליאל contradicts it.
steps.terutzMaskana: שמואל's rule follows יש זיקה. רבן גמליאל holds אין זיקה, so one חליצה frees both women.

steps.title: Opening a question from רבן גמליאל's view that there is no זיקה
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא takes the answer from Step 14, that רבן גמליאל holds אין זיקה, and starts to build a new challenge on it.
steps.simpleTranslation: But since רבן גמליאל holds that there is no זיקה...
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is setting up its next move. It takes what we just learned, that רבן גמליאל holds אין זיקה, and starts a question that will be finished in the next line.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In Step 14, saying רבן גמליאל holds אין זיקה saved שמואל. Now the גמרא turns that same idea into a possible problem. If there is no real bond between the יבם and the widow, some of רבן גמליאל's other rulings may no longer make sense.

keyTerms.meaning: The bond between the יבם and the widow, created when her husband dies with no children
The view that this bond has no real legal strength
"And since...": a phrase that takes an earlier point and builds a question on it

steps.confusionAlert: This line is not a full question yet. It only gives the starting point. The real challenge comes in the next line of the גמרא.

phrases.english: But since רבן גמליאל holds
phrases.notes: This goes right back to the answer in Step 14, where we found out what רבן גמליאל holds.

phrases.english: that there is no זיקה,

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Takes the answer of Step 14 (רבן גמליאל holds אין זיקה) and uses it as the starting point for a new challenge.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבן גמליאל's rulings in the ברייתא, now read as following the view of אין זיקה
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If רבן גמליאל really holds there is no זיקה, then his other rulings will be checked to see if they fit that view. The details of the challenge come in the next line.
